_comment.source: Asana's documented API: workspace memberships (https://developers.asana.com/reference/getworkspacemembershipsforworkspace), addUser and removeUser (https://developers.asana.com/reference/adduserforworkspace, https://developers.asana.com/reference/removeuserforworkspace). Asana only offers SCIM on Enterprise; these endpoints work on Starter and Advanced.
_comment.credential: A personal access token of an organization admin, sent as a bearer token. It acts as that admin and expires as the organization's token policy says (ten years by default).
_comment.base_url: The customer's organization: https://app.asana.com/api/1.0/workspaces/<organization id>. Every request stays under it, so the token is only ever used on that one organization.
_comment.membership: Being listed is having access: an invite is listed as an active member at once, and a removed member drops off the list. There is no suspend, so a leaver is removed. An inactive membership has no access and is left out. The organization's plain user list is not used: it does not page and stops at 2000 people.
_comment.remove: Asana transfers what a removed person owned to the owner of the token. Their private work is lost unless they make it public first.
